title: Sassy’s Silver Springs Kayak and Paddleboard Tours
includes: Boats, paddles, life vests, and dry bags are included.
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We provide thrilling wildlife encounters in the crystal clear waters of the Florida Springs. Our guides will take you to meet manatees, monkeys, alligators, turtles, and much more wildlife as you leisurely paddle through the pristine waters. Our guides will also point out hidden relics along with river and teach you all about the local history of the area.
